title: SBR Marine Boat Rentals
specs: Boats ready and waiting in the water, no need to launch or fuel
Primary driver must be at least 21 years old
Primary driver must have a valid government-issued driver's license
Boat operator must remain sober and capable of safe operation at all times
Multi-day rentals allow mooring at your own dock overnight
Captain services available by request, subject to availability

blurb: SBR Marine Boat Rentals offers fully insured boat rentals on Lake Nacimiento. Boats come fully fueled and ready in the water, including life jackets and safety gear. Multi-day rentals with discounts and optional captain services are available.
extraNote: Cancellations 14 days or more before rental date get full refund · Cancellations within 14 days are non-refundable but may be transferred to a future date · SBR Marine reserves right to deny or terminate rental without refund if operator appears impaired or unsafe · Lake Nacimiento Resort marina, 10625 Nacimiento Lake Drive, Bradley, CA 93426, at the marina slips (first six to the left)
